messages:
maya_cs: FYI Sparkline usage dropped ~38% this week, health score 44. Thinking a short 'activation bridge' save: enablement + temporary credit. Who can take the warm handoff?

devin_csm: I can. Onboarding shows `evals` step incomplete and one auth error flagged. I messaged their eng yesterday but no reply.

maya_cs: Thanks — can you run a quick audit and ping @anita_success with the items? Keep it two-touch.

devin_csm: Will do. Quick audit checklist I'm using:
```
- verify auth fix / oauth tokens
- confirm sample prompt walkthrough completed
- schedule 30m enablement session (record)
- propose temporary bridge plan (30d) vs full downgrade
- capture feedback in ticket
```

anita_success: On it. I'll assemble an enablement packet + 1-pager for AMs. Suggest offering a usage credit rather than an upfront discount — better signal for product value.

eli_pm: Note on downgrade: basic tier removes batch embeddings. Recommend a 30d 'bridge' with embeddings at 50% rate limit so they can keep core flows running. I'll draft the plan text and the parity matrix.

maya_cs: Perfect. Also want a tight feedback loop: capture NPS-like sentiment and one technical question post-session. Keep survey <=3 q's.

devin_csm: I'll run the session Tue 10am PT and invite Sparkline CSM + one eng. Adding calendar now.

maya_cs: ops_bot — please create a tracker ticket under `cs-feedback/activation` and tag with renewal-risk so we have audit trail.

ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-3209 — "Sparkline activation friction: missing evals + auth error". Link: https://redwood/CS-3209 :white_check_mark:

anita_success: Building the play materials now. I'll attach the script, sample prompts, and a short post-session survey template (3 Qs).

devin_csm: Added session note to the handoff doc and included the temporary bridge pricing language. If they don't respond within 48h after session, escalate to 1:1 renewal outreach and offer 15% usage credit valid 45 days.

maya_cs: Good. Also log explicit rollback steps if they downgrade so we can re-enable features quickly. Put those in the runbook under `downgrade-rollback`.

eli_pm: I'll add the parity checklist and a short blurb product can use in AM outreach.

maya_cs: Thanks team. After the session, we'll reconvene briefly and close CS-3209 once all items are done. :thumbsup:

devin_csm: Got it — will update after the call.
